description: React Native component for displaying order status with visual indicators, timestamps, and status messages in a food delivery app.

classes.name: Status
classes.description: Main React component managing and displaying order status progression.

classes.name: StatusRow
classes.description: Subcomponent representing individual status step with icon, label, timestamp, and optional address.

classes.name: StatusMessage
classes.description: Subcomponent displaying the main status message and subtext.

classes.name: Icon
classes.description: Subcomponent rendering status icon based on order state.

methods.name: formatTime
methods.description: Formats a date string into a localized short time string.
